name: Red Cottage
description: A falu-red cottage by the woods near Punkanjoki: a woodshed, an apple tree and its own little sauna. There is only one. Eila rents it out for the owners' estate until somebody buys it.
greeting: Birds sing in the birch trees.
The apple tree is in bloom.

hello: The previous owner had such nice roses.
You should put the sauna on. It's Saturday somewhere.
rent: I'll tell the estate you're a good tenant. Rent at the start of the month, dear.
Lovely! Just don't let the apple tree die.
buy: Oh how lovely, a young person moving in!
move_in: Back home! I watered the plants.
pay_rent: Thank you, dear. I'll send it on to the estate.
Right on time. Have a blueberry.
relax: Enjoy the sauna, dear. I'll keep an eye on things.
broke: Ooh, it's not cheap, is it? Save up, dear.

lines: The fire crackles. You could stare at it all evening. You do.
You poke the fire. It pokes back with a spark on your sock.
The rocking chair creaks back and forth by itself. Probably the draught. Probably.
You sit in the rocking chair and feel instantly forty years older. It's lovely.

actions.label: Rent the cottage
actions.description: Live here until somebody buys the place. Rent is due monthly; the first month is paid now. If the cottage is sold, you have to move out.

effects.message: You rent the red cottage. Woodshed, apple tree, your own sauna. Eila brings blueberries before you have unpacked.
The cottage is yours! No more rent, ever.

actions.label: Relax at the cottage
actions.description: Wood-fired sauna and a swim in the river.

then.message: Another sauna. You are now more steam than person. Eila asks if you're feeling all right.

else.message: Wood-fired sauna, a cold dip, a sausage on the fire. Bliss.
